descriptionByLocale.it:
Le tue responsabilità
• Sviluppo del prodotto dall'idea alla produzione di serie di tecnologie di azionamento esigenti e compiti meccatronici
• Sviluppo del software integrato e del software di livello superiore per la piattaforma elettronica e la tecnologia di azionamento
• Sviluppo e manutenzione di hardware per componenti di piattaforma
• Ulteriori sviluppi e manutenzione di software e hardware per i prodotti esistenti
• Responsabilità nel team Scrum per la concezione, lo sviluppo e la manutenzione di firmware, tecnologia di azionamento e elettronica
• Documentazione software e automazione dei test
• Garantire requisiti di sicurezza e qualità Il tuo profilo
• ingegnere elettrico laureato /- in FH / ETH
• Conoscenza della programmazione di software incorporato in C, C++ e tecnologia di controllo e di azionamento
• Esperienza con Altium per lo sviluppo di stampa di schema e layout, nonché con EtherCAT, CAN e IO-Link
• Esperienza con sistemi operativi in tempo reale incorporati (ad esempio FreeRTOS) e sviluppo software in ambienti Linux
• La conoscenza nello sviluppo agile di hardware e software con SAFe / Scrum è vantaggiosa
• Godetevi attività interdisciplinari e impegnative nel team e macchine tecnicamente impegnative
• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese I vantaggi Il vostro nuovo luogo di lavoro a Dierikon è dotato delle più recenti tecnologie e attrezzature di lavoro. Il vostro posto di lavoro si trova in uno dei moderni uffici open-plan, dove ci sono anche aree di incontro ispiranti e una grande terrazza per vari eventi dei dipendenti. Komax AG offre ai propri dipendenti modelli flessibili di tempo di lavoro e ufficio. L'ulteriore formazione dei dipendenti è importante per Komax AG, il che significa, ad esempio, che beneficiano di corsi di inglese interni gratuiti o l'accesso a piattaforme di apprendimento attraenti selezionate. Nella posizione di Dierikon, ci sono moderne sale relax e la possibilità di un pranzo scontato in un ristorante partner vicino. Hai delle domande? Siamo a vostra disposizione per ulteriori informazioni: Julian Singer HR Business Partner julian.singer@komaxgroup.com
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your responsibilities
• Product development from the idea to series production of demanding drive technology and mechatronic tasks
• Development of embedded software as well as the higher-level machine software for the electronics platform and drive technology
• Development and maintenance of hardware for platform components
• Further development and maintenance of software and hardware for existing products
• Responsibility in the Scrum team for conception, development and maintenance for firmware, drive technology and electronics
• Software documentation and test automation
• Ensuring safety and quality requirements Your profile
• Graduated electrical engineer /- in FH / ETH
• Knowledge of programming of embedded software in C, C++ as well as control and drive technology
• Experience with Altium for the print development of schema and layout as well as with EtherCAT, CAN and IO-Link
• Experience with embedded real-time operating systems (e.g. FreeRTOS) as well as software development in Linux environments
• Knowledge in the agile development of hardware and software with SAFe / Scrum is advantageous
• Enjoy interdisciplinary, challenging tasks in the team as well as technically demanding machines
• Very good German and good English skills Your benefits Your new place of work in Dierikon is equipped with the latest technology and work equipment. Your workplace is located in one of the modern open-plan offices, where there are also inspiring meeting areas and a large terrace for various employee events. Komax AG offers its employees flexible working time models and home office. The further training of employees is important to Komax AG, which means, for example, that they benefit from free internal English courses or access to selected attractive learning platforms. At the Dierikon location, there are modern break rooms as well as the possibility of a discounted lunch in a neighbouring partner restaurant. Do you have questions? We are at your disposal for further information: Julian Singer HR Business Partner julian.singer@komaxgroup.com
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Aufgabengebiet

• Produkteentwicklung von der Idee bis zur Serienfertigung von anspruchsvollen antriebstechnischen und mechatronischen Aufgabenstellungen

• Entwicklung von Embedded-Software sowie der übergeordneten Maschinensoftware für die Elektronik-Plattform und Antriebstechnik

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Hardware für Plattformkomponenten

• Weiterentwicklung sowie Unterhalt von Software und Hardware bei bestehenden Produkten

• Verantwortung im Scrum-Team für Konzeption, Entwicklung sowie Unterhalt für Firmware, Antriebstechnik und Elektronik

• Softwaredokumentation und Testautomatisierungen

• Sicherstellung der Sicherheits- und Qualitätsanforderungen

Ihr Profil

• Diplomierte/-r Elektroingenieur/-in FH / ETH

• Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von Embedded Software in C, C++ sowie Regelungs- und Antriebstechnik

• Erfahrungen mit Altium für die Printentwicklung von Schema und Layout sowie mit EtherCAT, CAN und IO-Link

• Erfahrung mit Embedded-Echtzeitbetriebssystemen (z.B. FreeRTOS) sowie Softwareentwicklung in Linux-Umgebungen von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse in der agilen Entwicklung von Hardware und Software mit SAFe / Scrum von Vorteil

• Freude an interdisziplinären, herausfordernden Aufgabenstellungen im Team sowie an technisch anspruchsvollen Maschinen

• Sehr gute Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse

Ihre Benefits

Ihr neuer Arbeitsort in Dierikon ist mit modernster Technik und Arbeitsmitteln ausgestattet. Ihr Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in einem der modernen Grossraumbüros, in denen es auch inspirierende Begegnungszonen sowie eine grosse Terrasse für diverse Mitarbeiteranlässe gibt. Die Komax AG bietet ihren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Home-Office. Die Weiterbildung der Mitarbeitenden liegt der Komax AG am Herzen, wodurch sie beispielsweise von kostenfreien internen Englischkursen oder Zugang zu ausgewählten attraktiven Lernplattformen profitieren. Am Standort Dierikon gibt es moderne Pausenräume sowie die Möglichkeit von vergünstigtem Mittagessen in einem benachbarten Partnerrestaurant.

Schleuniger di Thun è una società tecnologica leader e dal 2010 fa parte del Gruppo Komax. descriptionByLocale.en:
Schleuniger in Thun is a leading technology company and has been part of the Komax Group since 2010. For decades, the company and its approximately 200 employees have set standards in semi-automatic cable processing – with innovative solutions and future-oriented technology. With its products, Schleuniger serves a wide range of customers from the automotive industry, transport, medical technology, aerospace, information and communication technology as well as industrial and consumer electronics. Your tasks
• You support our customers and representatives in technical problems (e-mail and telephone)
• As a service technician you carry out commissioning and maintenance at the customer
• You test new machines and software versions from development
• You train our customers and representatives on our products (in Thun and worldwide)
• Support at fairs and customer visits Your profile
• Basic technical training (mechanical / electronic), commercial training of advantage
• Very good German and English knowledge in word and writing
• Knowledge Windows and Office programs and CRM system desirable
• Enjoy daily customer contact
• Reliable and independent working methods
• Team-ready and flexible Our offer
• Exciting and varied challenge in a global technology company
• Dynamic and innovative environment
• Family, value-oriented corporate culture and trusting cooperation
• Flexible working time models and modern infrastructure
• Great employee events We look forward to receiving your application! Do you have any questions? We are at your disposal for further information Reto Feller jobs@schleuniger.ch
